test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: One fourth of the pencil is black, half of the remaining part is green and the remaining part of the pencil is yellow. If the length of the yellow part is 1(1)/(2) cm, then what will be the length of the pencil?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the yellow part = 1¹⁄₂ cm

One fourth of the pencil is black.

Half of the remaining part is green.

Calculation**:**

Let the total length of the pencil be L cm.

Black part = L × (1⁄4)

Remaining part after black = L - L × (1⁄4) = (3L⁄4)

Green part = (1⁄2) × (3L⁄4) = (3L⁄8)

Yellow part = Remaining part after black and green

Yellow part = (3L⁄4) - (3L⁄8)

Yellow part = 1¹⁄₂ cm = (3⁄2) cm

Remaining part after black and green:

⇒ (3L⁄4) - (3L⁄8)

⇒ (6L⁄8) - (3L⁄8)

⇒ (3L⁄8)

Given that (3L⁄8) = (3⁄2)

⇒ 3L = 12

⇒ L = 4 cm

**∴ The length of the pencil is 4 cm.**
